name: web-video-presentation
notes: Offline publication cleanup: research dataset, historical media and archives excluded; 60 styles retained. Owner authorized MIT for rights-controlled original code; source ownership and media permission remain separately scoped.

Offline audit repair candidate: explicit TTS authorization, pre-resolve cross-platform paths, production gap rejection, max-end duration and safe numeric arithmetic; no browser/render acceptance claim.
Original optional object handoff tracks reuse the existing chapter event clock; no new timing table or dependency.
Bounded opt-in Canvas temporal supersampling with premultiplied alpha; sharp fallback is explicit.
60 styles, approval gates, audio-none/tts/provided, Alpha and composite routes preserved.
New runtime is model/scaffold tested, not browser-rendered or customer accepted.
historicalNotes: Starting in v2.9.0, workflow gates are hardened: acceptedChapterIds + chapter-review events, draft/smoke requires --acknowledge-draft when gates are incomplete, overlay rgba/text-stroke preflight, Remotion Hook-in-map static scan, outline/registry/shot-manifest drift detection, reference-video resolution guard, npm run render:alpha:smoke, and run-studio.cjs auto port selection. Lessons 18/19/27/28/33/35 downgrade to [AUTO] (27→32).

Starting in v2.8.0, transparent alpha export is productized: built-in TransparentFix + overlayChapterIds + full-video-alpha composition, render:video:alpha with ProRes 4444 alpha guards, script coverage gate, stage SVG viewBox gate, and lesson lifecycle downgrade [AUTO] 22→27.
Read VERSION or VERSION.json first; this skill may be distributed without a .git directory.
Do not infer the skill version from file timestamps, project folder names, or git commands.
Starting in v2.0.0, scaffolded projects are Remotion-first and no longer use Vite/Web presentation as the preview runtime.
This is a major workflow break from the previous Web/Vite presentation-first line.
Starting in v2.0.4, official delivery packages exclude legacy Vite/Web template leftovers even if source mirrors still keep deprecated files for non-destructive compatibility.

Starting in v2.1.0, workflow evidence, first-chapter anchor gates, full shot-design review, 50+ premium themes, Pexels asset candidate search, final-render state guards are part of the enterprise contract.
Starting in v2.1.1, production incident lessons are enforced by render-safe CSS gates, format metadata checks, post-fix golden validation rules, and render-result SHA256 metadata.

Starting in v2.1.2, serious fix-agent failures are converted into hard workflow gates: automatic gate-result evidence, chapter registry drift checks, Remotion staticFile asset-path checks, timing-warning failures, explicit TTS provider voice evidence, and nested generated-project guards.
Starting in v2.1.3, reusable Remotion/HyperFrames/community-inspired motion patterns are enforced through MOTION-PATTERN-LIBRARY.md, visualRecipe, and motionStyle fields in shot-manifest.json.

Starting in v2.1.4, projects use profile-first entry (douyin / bilibili / custom), require shot-design.md before chapter development, include Lottie and OpenDesign workflow rules, require final MP4 for every profile, and package final videos plus delivery-summary evidence into a desktop ZIP.

Starting in v2.1.5, douyin/portrait projects require a post-render Remotion cover workflow: cover:generate, cover:validate, cover evidence, and package:delivery inclusion. The cover uses a <=10-character title from the first three frames/opening hook, a representative visual above the title, and the supplied overlay image without occluding key elements.
Starting in v2.1.5, the built-in theme library includes soft-neu: a mist-gray soft neumorphic course/product UI style based on user-provided soft-neu export.

Starting in v2.1.6, cover generation is hardened for delivery: UTF-8 BOM JSON inputs are tolerated, local Edge/Chrome is auto-detected for Remotion still rendering, cover titles scale as true short-video headlines, cover backgrounds follow the active video theme, and validation proves the overlay is present in final cover pixels.

Starting in v2.1.7, JSON-reading delivery gates tolerate UTF-8 BOM where appropriate, and package:delivery fails loudly when required workflow JSON cannot be parsed instead of silently bypassing cover/final-render checks.
Starting in v2.1.8, cover visuals use a dark cinematic background, no glyph stroke/black edge on title text, and a more representative semantic flow-to-core SVG visual above the title.

Starting in v2.1.9, douyin cover generation is hardened against weak video-frame-like covers: titles must occupy the cover headline band, representative visuals must be cover-grade rather than thumbnail-like, and portrait/mobile shots must declare mobileReadability hard evidence in shot-manifest.json.
Starting in v2.1.9, cover titles default to one line; short titles such as AI未来前景 must not wrap, and cover:validate blocks title wrapping.

Starting in v2.1.10, reference-video learning requires continuous-frame motion analysis via REFERENCE-VIDEO-STYLES.md, and adds validated kinetic-prompt-to-product / annotated-flow-diagram recipes plus prompt-product-kinetic / whiteboard-engineering-flow motion styles.

Starting in v2.1.11, those reference-video styles are code-backed by src/video/reference-style-scenes.tsx, scaffolded into every project, validated by preflight, and verified in both landscape and portrait Remotion projects. Subtitles now default from project-state.json when requested, so Studio preview and MP4 rendering share the same subtitle intent unless REMOTION_SUBTITLES=0 is explicitly set.

Starting in v2.2.0, reference-video and complex-motion workflows require motion-strip verification: generated projects include scripts/render-motion-strips.ts, npm run render:motion-strips, npm run render:motion-strips:fast, and preflight blocks reference-video recipe/style steps without output/motion-strips/manifest.json continuous-frame evidence.

Starting in v2.2.3, reference-video workflows require source-video analysis evidence: generated projects include scripts/analyze-reference-videos.ts, npm run analyze:references, preflight blocks referenceVideo/referenceVideoStyle shots without output/reference-video-analysis/manifest.json, and package:delivery includes that evidence.

Starting in v2.2.3, motion-strip verification supports parallel still rendering via --parallel and defaults to 2 concurrent renders, making reference-style evidence generation faster and less likely to time out.

Starting in v2.2.3, motion-strip manifests include per-frame SHA256/bytes and per-step distinctFrameHashes; preflight requires those hashes for reference-video style shots to prove actual visual change, not just different frame numbers.

Starting in v2.2.4, generated projects include scripts/validate-delivery.ts and npm run validate:delivery. package:delivery runs it first and includes output/delivery-validation.json in the customer handoff bundle.

Starting in v2.2.5, generated projects include scripts/compare-reference-style.ts and npm run compare:references. Reference-video workflows now produce output/reference-style-comparison with a machine-readable verdict that the result is motion-grammar mapping, not an identical copy, unless exact shared frame hashes indicate copy risk.
Public release v2.2 includes the complete v2.2.x hardening line through internal revision v2.2.15.

Starting in v2.2.15, reference-style comparison also emits a dynamic-structure verdict that checks entry / reveal / readable-hold / exit coverage from motion-strip metadata, so agents can distinguish exact-copy risk from same-grammar different-execution evidence.

Starting in v2.2.14, delivery-chain JSON readers are BOM-safe for asset manifests, timing manifests, project state, feedback events, subtitles export, final render gates, and TTS segments, preventing Windows/editor/agent encoding drift from breaking preflight or rendering.

Starting in v2.2.13, every step must record subtitleSafety geometry evidence. Preflight and final delivery validation block text or critical visual boxes that collide with subtitle bands or portrait/douyin platform UI bands.

Starting in v2.2.12, draft/smoke/frame-range renders write per-output metadata under output/render-results/*.json and cannot overwrite output/render-result.json. Final delivery accepts only quality full render evidence for output/full.mp4.

Starting in v2.2.11, final delivery validation reruns screen-text validation, keeps detailed duplicate-text errors, and limits opening/ending subtitle-overlap exceptions to short 12-normalized-character labels.
Starting in v2.2.10, accepted feedback events must contain evidence: user-facing accepted events require userQuote, and gate-result accepted events require pass status plus validation evidence.
Starting in v2.2.9, delivery validation checks workflow acceptance evidence in feedback-events.jsonl. State flags alone and script-generated pending events no longer count as acceptance.

Starting in v2.2.8, render-result.json records ffprobe mediaProbe evidence for final MP4 stream count, audio track presence, duration, fps, dimensions, codecs, and audio channel/sample-rate evidence. Delivery validation blocks missing mediaProbe, missing audio streams when audio is requested, and major duration/fps/size mismatches.

Starting in v2.2.7, TTS synthesis writes output/tts-manifest.json with narration text hashes, provider, voice/profile, audio SHA256, file size, and per-step status. Delivery validation blocks missing/stale audio when narrations, provider, or voice change.

Starting in v2.2.6, mainline source mirrors and installed skill directories remove the legacy Vite/Web runtime leftovers (templates/index.html, templates/vite.config.ts, templates/src/App.tsx, templates/src/main.tsx, old stepper/progress/autoplay components, and old hooks) so agents cannot accidentally revive the pre-Remotion workflow.

Starting in v2.2.16, cover system renders single-layer per Cover Design Handbook. Portrait size 1440x3200. On-screen text count hard-gated (max 2/step, 3 opening-ending). Animation stack adds animejs + Pixabay + CardArrayFlow. Single-track versioning.

Starting in v2.2.17, DOUYIN BLOGGER DISTILLATION RELEASE. 新增 douyin-laon (老七聊AI风格) + douyin-skill (每天一个必备skill风格) 两个Profile; 新增 dark-tech-glow + practical-skill 两个主题; 新增7段式脚本模板; 双风格完整对比表; Whisper转写工具链。

Starting in v2.5.0, 抖音审核合规红线落地 (6.22 事故): SKILL.md/VIDEO-PROFILES.md/CHAPTER-CRAFT.md 新增禁止安装命令/终端画面/外链引导/安装式CTA规则，内容定位仅限「种草」，引导平台外的内容会被降播放量; 每步 shot-manifest.json 新增 platformCompliance 字段，preflight/validate:delivery 阻断违规信号。
Starting in v2.5.0, 字幕字数收紧 15-20字 → 10-15字 (6.16 反馈)，SKILL.md/DELIVERY.md/README/README.zh-CN/AUDIO.md/PRODUCTION-WORKFLOW.md/QUALITY-GATE.md 7 处同步。

Starting in v2.5.0, 字幕 75% 红线: 竖屏/抖音字幕底部不得低于画面 75% 高度处，subtitleBand 从 y=0.66/h=0.16 收紧到 y=0.60/h=0.13 (占60%-73%)，FORMATS.md/build-shot-manifest.ts/Subtitle.css/preflight.ts/validate-delivery.ts 同步，preflight 阻断 subtitleBand.y+height>0.75。
Starting in v2.5.0, 封面分辨率固定 1080×1440 (与视频画幅 1440×3200 解耦): generate-cover.ts/validate-cover.ts/CoverRoot.tsx 改用封面专用尺寸常量，validate-cover 校验封面为 1080×1440; COVER-WORKFLOW.md 重写。
Starting in v2.5.0, 封面可选 overlay 两层架构恢复 (6.16-P1): 默认单层 Remotion，用户提供封面模板 PNG 时切换两层叠加; 封面生成失败 3 次自动回退视频关键帧截图方案; Shot Design Review 阶段主动询问用户是否有封面模板。
Starting in v2.5.0, Remotion 缓存清理硬规则 (6.16-P1): render:golden/cover:video 重做前必须清理 .remotion bundle 缓存，解决「重做未生效」事故。

Starting in v2.5.0, TTS 用户 provider 偏好记录 (6.16-P2): project-state.json.ttsPreferences 记录用户选择/拒绝的 provider，同项目不重复询问; 并行开发后强制 build-shot-manifest --force (6.16-P2); OUTLINE-FORMAT.md 补充 douyin 单步 6s 上限自检 (6.16-P0); CHAPTER-CRAFT.md 新增竖屏底部安全区/全屏利用率自检、抖音禁止静默 step (6.16-P1)。
Starting in v2.5.0, 版本号递增规则文档化: VERSION.md 新增「版本号递增规则」章节，小修 PATCH/中修 MINOR/大修 MAJOR 判定标准与操作清单。

Starting in v2.5.2, 文案去AI味深度融合 Humanizer-zh 24 模式方法论: references/SCRIPT-STYLE.md 去AI味从「五类腔调」扩为「十类模式清单」(新增 AI高频词黑名单/破折号加粗括号/虚假范围同义词循环/谄媚填充/模糊归因夸大象征)，新增「注入灵魂」小节(有观点/承认复杂/允许混乱/对感受具体)，自检从三层升为四层(形式/风骨/50分量化/念出来)，50分评分(直接性节奏信任度真实性精炼度各10分，45+通过/<35整稿重写)，两个脚本模板检查清单联动，SKILL.md 两处引用同步。

Starting in v2.5.3, 封面单独复制 (PATCH): 新增 npm run cover:copy 命令，只把封面 PNG 复制到桌面，不走 package:delivery 全项目打包; 用户说「做个封面」时走 cover:generate→cover:validate→cover:copy，完整交付才走 package:delivery; 新增 templates/scripts/copy-cover.ts; COVER-WORKFLOW.md/SKILL.md/Codex.md/AGENT-RULEBOOK.md/PRODUCTION-WORKFLOW.md/README/README.zh-CN/DELIVERY.md/TRANSFER.md 9 处文档同步。
Starting in v2.5.3, 文案模板红线 (PATCH): references/SCRIPT-STYLE.md 万能模板章节新增「不是...而是...」否定-转折骨架和「先说...再说.../最明显的...」步骤预告骨架两个必清子节，含反面例子/修改原则/全文搜索自检方法; 风骨层自检清单新增两条检查项。

Starting in v2.6.0, 视频素材处理子系统 (MINOR, 6.26 事故 P0): 新增 references/VIDEO-ASSETS.md 完整规范视频素材入库流程——public/videos/ 目录约定 + staticFile() 引用 + asset-manifest.json 新增 type:video 字段(fps/durationSec/width/height/orientation); 源素材 fps 必须归一化到项目 fps(默认60)，24/30fps 源用 ffmpeg minterpolate 转码，preflight 阻断 fps 不匹配; 章节组件必须用 <OffthreadVideo>(@remotion/video) 而非原生 <video>，preflight 扫描 src/chapters 和 src/components 阻断 <video> JSX 标签; scaffold.sh 依赖新增 @remotion/video; CardArrayFlow.tsx 占位符黑块改为真 OffthreadVideo; RENDERING.md 新增视频素材帧率匹配 + <video> 禁用 + render:smoke 验证; CHAPTER-CRAFT.md 新增平台审核反模式清单 + 大号 CJK 文字抖动红线(>=48px 禁与 revealStyle y!=0/will-change 同用) + 完工自检 3 条; QUALITY-GATE.md 新增视频素材校验 + 封面首次失败停止规则; COVER-WORKFLOW.md 新增首次验证失败停止规则 + 封面标题手动输入优先; SKILL.md 文件指南/企业红线/相关资源/方案确认 4 处同步。

Starting in v2.6.0, 大号 CJK 文字抖动红线 (6.26 事故 P0): >=48px CJK 文字禁与 revealStyle({y:非0}) 或 will-change:transform 同时使用; 标签文字优先 absolute 定位脱离 flex 流 + 纯 interpolate opacity(零 transform); flex 容器内禁同级 GPU 合成层动画元素; 事故根因为提示词工程项目标签在 flex 内 + will-change + 同级视频 GPU 层导致亚像素抖动 4 轮未修复。

Starting in v2.6.0, 重大修改前先展示方案 (6.26 事故 P2): 涉及 >3 文件或需要重新渲染的修改(如全项目 <video>→<OffthreadVideo> 迁移、章节视觉大改、封面重做)，先列修改方案给用户看过再执行，不直接改完才汇报; 用户原话「先不要渲染...列出修改方案给我看过再执行」。
